name: DeadEasy Player
summary:
You want to watch 3D in real 3D? This does that.

DeadEasy Player plays your 3D movies the way they were meant to be seen — side-by-side and over-under videos, in actual 3D, right in your headset.

Plays files from your device or over your network. Other apps can hand videos off to it too — use it as the external player for apps like Plezy.

Simple. No fuss. Just 3D that works.  

Subtitle and multiple audio streams supported.
